verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a free tier or trial. Pricing-page snippets such as "Unlimited search" are not tied to any free plan. Notes that Pro and above are needed for table export and API access, and that report export works "regardless of which Elicit plan", only imply that other plans exist; none says a free or trial plan exists or what it includes.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can try the product meaningfully on a free tier or trial
